narration: There's a number on your credit card statement the bank hopes you never calculate. Pay just the minimum on a $5,000 balance and you'll spend the next 22 years paying it off.
visual: Credit card floating in center of dark screen, statement paper unfurling below it. Minimum payment line highlighted in red with a dollar amount. '22 YEARS' text springs in large.

narration: Number one — the minimum is a trap, not a favor. Banks set it at 1 to 2 percent of your balance so it barely touches the principal. You're almost exclusively paying interest.
visual: Pie chart showing $5,000 balance split: small green slice labeled 'PRINCIPAL' vs massive red slice labeled 'INTEREST'. Animated slice growing on the interest side.

narration: Number two — at 24 percent APR, a $5,000 balance balloons to $24,000 paid total. That's $19,000 in pure interest — nearly four times what you originally charged.
visual: Two stacked bars side by side: left bar '$5,000 original debt' in white, right bar '$24,000 total paid' in red towering above it. Dollar labels animate in.

narration: Number three — minimum payments shrink as your balance drops, which means your payoff date keeps moving further away. The bank engineered it that way. Wild, right?
visual: Timeline arrow stretching right across the screen. Milestone markers at 5 years, 10 years, 15 years, 22 years. Red debt bar barely shrinking across the timeline.

narration: Number four — that convenience check your bank mailed you? It starts a new balance at an even higher rate. Each one resets the clock and adds thousands more. That's the cycle they want.
visual: Envelope opening to reveal a paper check labeled 'CONVENIENCE CHECK'. Behind it, a clock face spinning forward, debt number incrementing upward.

narration: Here's the fix: add just $50 extra to your payment every month. That alone cuts your 22-year payoff down to 4 years and saves over $15,000. Follow for more traps banks hide from you.
visual: Split screen: left side shows long winding debt road labeled '22 years', right side shows short straight road labeled '4 years'. Piggy bank filling up on the right side. CTA text: 'ADD $50/MONTH'.
